texts.zh:
[From.GetName]行星是一片有毒废土，但是我们的扫描发现这里曾经不是现在这样的。一个如今已毁灭的文明因为过度依赖改变气候的燃料和毒素而彻底毁了自己的这个母星。

在一个大城市附近的一处偏僻山丘上，我们发现了一座还能运行的设施。这是一个组装机器人的工厂，周围泊满了军用车辆。但这些车辆稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
texts.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]星球是一片剧毒而有腐蚀性的废土，但我们的扫描发现它并非一直如此。一个现已灭绝的有机体文明似乎因重度依赖改变气候的燃料与毒素，而摧毁了自己的母星。

在靠近一座大型城市的偏远的山丘上，我们发现了一个尚在运行的设施。这是一个荒弃的机器人组装工厂，周围泊满了严重腐朽的军用车辆，稍稍一碰就化成了尘埃。

这座设施非常神秘奇特，但也许能够提供不少研究材料。
texts.en:
The planet [From.GetName] is a toxic, corrosive wasteland, but our scans unveil that it has not always been so. A now extinct organic civilization seems to have destroyed its home planet, via a heavy reliance on climate altering fuels and toxins.

On a remote hill, close to a major city, we have found a lone active facility. A robot assembly plant, desolated and surrounded by military vehicles, so deteriorated they break upon touch.

The facility is alien and mysterious, but could provide us with ample study material.

texts.zh:
[From.From.From.GetName]上的那座设施因为科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的努力而恢复运作了。

机器人们启动后马上各就各位工作。[From.GetName]的船员们目瞪口呆，看着机器人们向四面八方移动，开始清除整颗星球上的毒素。

这不禁让人猜测之前的居住者是因为过度关注于自相残杀而忽略了自救。
texts.en:
The facility on [From.From.From.GetName] lights up as Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s plan finally comes to fruition.

The robots activate and immediately move with purpose. The crew of the [From.GetName] stare in shock, but warrantedly so, as the machines move out across the world, starting to cleanse the toxicity from it.

One could assume that the previous inhabitants were too wrapped up in conflict to save themselves.

texts.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
texts.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.
